methods.name: public String getIsdnSubAddress()
methods.comment: Returns the value of the isdnSubAddress parameter, or null * if it is not set. * * @return the value of the isdnSubAddress parameter

methods.name: public String getPostDial()
methods.comment: Returns the value of the postDial parameter, or null if it * is not set. * * @return the value of the postDial parameter

methods.name: public String getScheme()
methods.comment:
Returns the value of the "scheme" of this URI, for example "sip", "sips"
     * or "tel".
     *
     * @return the scheme paramter of the URI

methods.name: public boolean isGlobal()
methods.comment: Returns true if this TelURL is global i.e. if the TelURI * has a global phone user. * * @return true if this TelURL represents a global phone user, * and false otherwise.

methods.name: public boolean isSipURI()
methods.comment:
This method determines if this is a URI with a scheme of "sip" or "sips".
     *
     * @return true if the scheme is "sip" or "sips", false otherwise.

methods.name: public void setGlobal(boolean global)
methods.comment:
Sets phone user of this TelURL to be either global or local. The default
     * value is false, hence the TelURL is defaulted to local.
     *
     * @param global - the boolean value indicating if the TelURL has a global
     * phone user.

methods.name: public void setIsdnSubAddress(String isdnSubAddress)
methods.comment: Sets ISDN subaddress of this TelURL. If a subaddress is present, it is * appended to the phone number after ";isub=". * * @param isdnSubAddress - new value of the isdnSubAddress * parameter

methods.name: public void setPostDial(String postDial)
methods.comment: Sets post dial of this TelURL. The post-dial sequence describes what and * when the local entity should send to the phone line. * * @param postDial - new value of the postDial parameter

methods.name: public void setPhoneNumber(String telephoneNumber)
methods.comment:
* Set the telephone number.
     * @param telephoneNumber long phone number to set.

methods.name: public String getPhoneNumber()
methods.comment:
Get the telephone number.
     *
     *@return -- the telephone number.

methods.name: public String toString()
methods.comment:
Return the string encoding.
     *
     *@return -- the string encoding.

methods.name: public Object clone()
methods.comment:
Deep copy clone operation.
    *
    *@return -- a cloned version of this telephone number.

methods.name: public void setParameter(String name, String value)
public void setPhoneContext(String phoneContext) throws ParseException

methodNames: public void setParameter(String name, String value)
public void setPhoneContext(String phoneContext) throws ParseException
